context: Kenji helps Hiroshi-elder use the train station ticket machine.
purpose: Adult patiently helping elder with tech.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: This machine doesn't make sense to me.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely puzzled. A slight chuckle underneath—not self-deprecating, just honest. Warm drawl, unhurried. Kansai lilt on the vowels.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おとうさん、行き先押して。
lines.en: Dad, you just press the destination button.
lines.style: Patient, gentle instruction. Warm without being patronizing. Kansai cadence, slight lilt upward at the end—more offering than correcting. Speaking as someone who's explained this before and will again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Quick realization, soft and wondering. A tiny uptick of hope in the voice. Reaches for understanding. Kansai musicality. Not rushed—he's checking, genuinely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yeah, that's it—ticket comes right out.
lines.style: Warm confirmation, almost encouraging. Kansai warmth threaded through. Light, reassuring. The tone of someone watching something click into place and being quietly pleased about it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, unhurried. Soft Kansai drawl. A little relief in there—not from the ticket, from being helped. Warm, without fussing. The kind of thanks that means something.
